text:
Sara (People Ops): Heads-up — intl new hire arriving Mon (Julia Chen). Passport valid but <6 months left. Can we run through I-9/E-Verify options and a notary plan? Also background check still in progress.

Omar (HR): We can do a remote I-9 if notarized AND we get a scanned passport + a local address for E-Verify. CA office can do in-person if she can make it day 1. Is she on a visa?

Sara (People Ops): She tagged H1-B on her application. If in-person, we can do ID + I-9 at badge desk. If remote, we'll need a certified notary copy and courier for originals on week 1.

Michael (IT): FYI re: laptop/shipping — we can ship + set up VPN on arrival. If we need a same-day pickup, badge desk has a handoff list. For shipping: `shipctl create --user julia.chen --model xps13 --expedite` (will need confirm addr).

Julia Chen: I can be in SF but won't land until 2pm on Monday. Is there a notary near the office that does same-day? Also when do I get benefits sign-up link? 

Lena (Facilities): Badge desk open 8:30–5:00. There's a notary service ~3 blocks from HQ (Civic Notary, 4th St) that does walk-ins until 4:30. If you arrive after 5pm we can arrange a courier for docs the next morning.

Sara (People Ops): Plan suggestion: schedule a 10:30am quick remote I-9 notarization call Tues AM if she lands late Mon. If she can do in-person before 5pm, do that. I'll open a courier ticket to ship originals back to HQ if notarized remotely. Background check team — any blockers?

Onboarding Bot: checklist updated — I-9 step set to "notary-scheduled"; background-check status: pending id verification.

Omar (HR): Background check flagged an address mismatch on the application; Sara can you confirm the address Julia wants payroll to use (this affects state tax). For H1-B, W-4 is standard but tax treaty stuff may apply if she has prior status — payroll will advise after you confirm address.

Michael (IT): Julia — if you want the laptop shipped to your temporary SF Airbnb we need the exact street + signed delivery waiver. Otherwise pickup at badge desk same day. Ping me DM to confirm.

Julia Chen: I'll DM the SF address now. Benefits question: when is enrollment window? Also orientation agenda — will I miss the intro sessions if I'm late Monday?

Sara (People Ops): Benefits enrollment opens on day 1 and you have 30 days to enroll. Monday morning we have a 9am org welcome + 1pm product intro; if you arrive after 2pm you'll miss the morning but we record the sessions and schedule a 1:1 intro with your manager. I'll add you to the orientation calendar and send the benefits link once HR marks background as cleared.

Michael (IT): Noted — will standby for your DM, Julia. If courier needed we can push expedited build and include power adapter + ethernet dongle.

Sara (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll set the notary option as fallback, try to get an in-person slot on Mon, and post final plan here by EOD. :thumbsup:
